name: Voxlect
description: Voxlect is a speech foundation model benchmark designed for modeling dialects and regional languages worldwide. It includes over 2 million training utterances from 30 publicly available speech corpora with dialectal information, enabling evaluation of dialect classification and robustness under noisy conditions.
reputation: A new benchmark proposed for evaluating speech foundation models on dialect and regional-language robustness, with early-stage adoption rather than broad community standardization.
notes: Publicly available with RAIL license; supports downstream applications such as augmenting ASR datasets with dialect info.
